name: gizza-ai/latex-table
summary: Convert CSV or TSV data into a LaTeX tabular.

tool.description: Convert CSV or TSV data into a LaTeX tabular environment. style=booktabs (default) uses \toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule (needs \usepackage{booktabs}); style=grid uses vertical bars and \hline; style=plain has no rules. alignment is a single l/c/r for all columns or a per-column string like 'lcr'. header=true (default) separates the first row with a rule; escape=true (default) escapes LaTeX special characters; bold_header wraps header cells in \textbf{}. Set caption and/or label to wrap the tabular in a centered table float. delimiter is 'auto' (detect), a single char, or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

data.description: The CSV or TSV text to convert.

delimiter.description: Field separator: 'auto' (detect CSV vs TSV), a single char, or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Default 'auto'.

style.description: Rule style: booktabs (\toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule, needs \usepackage{booktabs}), grid (vertical bars + \hline), or plain (no rules).

alignment.description: Column alignment: a single l/c/r applied to all columns, or a per-column string like 'lcr'.

header.description: Treat the first row as the header (default true); a \midrule/\hline separates it from the body.

escape.description: Escape LaTeX special characters (& % $ # _ { } ~ ^ \) in cells (default true). Turn off to keep raw LaTeX.

caption.description: Optional caption; if set (or label is), the tabular is wrapped in a centered table float.

label.description: Optional \label for cross-references; if set (or caption is), the tabular is wrapped in a table float.
